name: 20852 · Rockville, MD
findings: ZIP 20852 (Rockville) has 405 nonprofit organizations. 164 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 136 organizations.
Research and think tank organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 20852 (Rockville) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
